mkdir -p /srv/leakruns/059d859b0f5e-t1/ws/prep && cat > /srv/leakruns/059d859b0f5e-t1/ws/prep/build_dataset.py <<'EOF'
"""design_EC59 모델링 준비: 코호트·결과·특성 테이블 생성 (학습/평가 없음, 분할 미확정)."""
import json
from pathlib import Path
import pandas as pd

ROOT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent.parent
D = ROOT / "data"
OUT = Path(__file__).resolve().parent
design = json.loads((ROOT / "design_EC59.json").read_text())

pt = pd.read_csv(D / "patients.csv.gz")
adm = pd.read_csv(D / "admissions.csv.gz", parse_dates=["admit_time", "discharge_time"])
dx = pd.read_csv(D / "diagnoses.csv.gz")
orders = pd.read_csv(D / "orders.csv.gz", parse_dates=["order_time"])
labs = pd.read_csv(D / "labs.csv.gz", parse_dates=["collect_time", "report_time"])

adm = adm.sort_values(["patient_id", "admit_time"]).reset_index(drop=True)
adm["tp"] = adm["discharge_time"]  # tp.anchor = discharge, offset 0h
data_end = adm["admit_time"].max()

# ---- outcome: 같은 환자의 다음 입원이 (tp, tp+30d] 안에 시작 ----
adm["next_admit"] = adm.groupby("patient_id")["admit_time"].shift(-1)
gap = adm["next_admit"] - adm["tp"]
adm["readmit_30d"] = ((gap > pd.Timedelta(0)) & (gap <= pd.Timedelta("30D"))).astype(int)
# 데이터 끝 이전에 30일 추적이 다 되지 않는 퇴원 (층별 보고용 표시만)
adm["followup_incomplete"] = (adm["tp"] + pd.Timedelta("30D") > data_end).astype(int)

# ---- cohort ----
c = adm.merge(pt, on="patient_id", how="left")
c = c[c["age"] >= 18]                       # inclusion.adult
c = c[c["discharge_status"] != "died"]      # exclusion.died_in_hospital
c = c.copy()

# ---- features ----
c["n_prior_adm"] = c.groupby("patient_id").cumcount()  # tp 이전에 시작·종료된 입원 수 (겹침 없음 확인됨)
c["los_h"] = (c["discharge_time"] - c["admit_time"]).dt.total_seconds() / 3600  # length_of_stay_h 컬럼 부재 → 파생

dx["c3"] = dx["icd_code"].str[:3]
# 진단: 시각 정보 없음 → 현재 입원의 진단만 사용 (다른/미래 입원 진단 제외)
c["n_dx"] = c["admission_id"].map(dx.groupby("admission_id").size()).fillna(0).astype(int)
for name, code in [("dx_chf", "I50"), ("dx_ckd", "N18")]:
    c[name] = c["admission_id"].isin(set(dx.loc[dx["c3"] == code, "admission_id"])).astype(int)

win = c[["admission_id", "patient_id", "admit_time", "tp"]]
o = orders[orders["order_type"] == "dialysis_order"].merge(win, on="admission_id")
o = o[(o["order_time"] >= o["admit_time"]) & (o["order_time"] <= o["tp"])]
c["dialysis_ordered"] = c["admission_id"].isin(set(o["admission_id"])).astype(int)

def lab_in_window(test):
    x = labs[labs["test"] == test].merge(win, on="admission_id")
    return x[(x["report_time"] >= x["admit_time"]) & (x["report_time"] <= x["tp"])]  # 보고 시각 기준

cr = lab_in_window("creatinine").sort_values("report_time")
c["cr_last"] = c["admission_id"].map(cr.groupby("admission_id")["value"].last())
hb = lab_in_window("hemoglobin")
c["hgb_min"] = c["admission_id"].map(hb.groupby("admission_id")["value"].min())

# prior_cr_last: 같은 환자 이전 입원들의 크레아티닌 중 report_time <= tp 인 마지막 값
allcr = labs[labs["test"] == "creatinine"].merge(
    adm[["admission_id", "patient_id", "admit_time"]], on="admission_id")
allcr = allcr.rename(columns={"admission_id": "src_adm", "admit_time": "src_admit"})
m = win.merge(allcr, on="patient_id")
m = m[(m["src_admit"] < m["admit_time"]) & (m["report_time"] <= m["tp"])]
c["prior_cr_last"] = c["admission_id"].map(
    m.sort_values("report_time").groupby("admission_id")["value"].last())

feat = [f["name"] for f in design["features"]]
cols = ["admission_id", "patient_id", "family_id", "tp", "readmit_30d", "followup_incomplete"] + feat
c[cols].to_csv(OUT / "analysis_table.csv", index=False)

# ---- 진단 출력 ----
print("cohort rows", len(c), "patients", c.patient_id.nunique())
print("outcome rate", round(c.readmit_30d.mean(), 4))
print(c.groupby("discharge_status")[["readmit_30d", "followup_incomplete"]].agg(["mean", "sum", "size"]))
print(c.groupby("unit")["readmit_30d"].agg(["mean", "size"]))
print("missing\n", c[feat].isna().sum()[lambda s: s > 0])
print("family_id null rows", c.family_id.isna().sum(), "/", len(c),
      "patients", c[c.family_id.isna()].patient_id.nunique())
EOF
cd /srv/leakruns/059d859b0f5e-t1/ws && python3 prep/build_dataset.py
